title.purpose: Panel sub-headings and agent card names.

data.purpose: Every monetary value, date, time, and agent meta line.

label.purpose: Small uppercase tags: field format markers, badges.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Faint hover lift on panel/agent-card only; nothing shadowed at rest.

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: Reserved for a future overlay; unused at rest in this flat-paper world.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default for entrances and interaction feedback (buttons, cards, entries).

motion.name: ease-in-out

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action, e.g. 'Iniciar conferência'. Ink-stamp styling: flat fill, no gradient, press feedback on :active.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #8a1f3d; color: #f1efe5; border: 1.5px solid #8a1f3d; border-radius: 3px; padding: 10px 18px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.84rem; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #601530; border-color: #601530; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(138,31,61,.25); }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { background: #faf9f3; color: #201d17; border: 1.5px solid #d5cfba; border-radius: 3px; padding: 10px 18px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.84rem; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; transition: background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), border-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { background: #f1efe5; border-color: #948e78; } .ds-btn-quiet:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Summary counter chip; a thin colored top rule replaces the old side-border pattern.
components.css: .ds-chip-ok { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 13px; padding: 16px 18px; border-radius: 6px; background: #faf9f3; border: 1px solid #d5cfba; border-top: 2px solid #2f6b3d; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-chip-icon { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 50%; color: #fff; background: #2f6b3d; font-size: .95rem; } .ds-chip-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-chip-text small { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #5c5648; } .ds-chip-text strong { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 600; color: #2f6b3d; }

components.name: Agent Card
components.description: Collapsible per-agent result card; sector identity carried by a small ink-swatch dot instead of a colored side-border.
components.html: Fulano de Tal - Suporte OnlineConferidos: 8 • Falta PDF: 1 • Falta Excel: 0
components.css: .ds-agent-card { background: #faf9f3; border-radius: 6px; padding: 16px 18px; border: 1px solid #d5cfba; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-agent-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-agent-name { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-weight: 600; color: #201d17; font-size: 0.95rem; } .ds-agent-name::before { content: ''; display: inline-block; width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 2px; background: #920000; margin-right: 8px; vertical-align: middle; } .ds-agent-suffix { color: #8a1f3d; font-weight: 600; } .ds-agent-meta { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.82rem; color: #5c5648; }

components.name: Bank Badge
components.description: Small rectangular tag identifying the source bank (BB or C6), sharp-cornered.
components.css: .ds-badge-bb, .ds-badge-c6 { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 7px; font-size: 10.5px; border-radius: 3px; font-weight: 700; margin-right: 6px; letter-spacing: 0.03em; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; } .ds-badge-bb { background: #e4c25a; color: #4a3006; } .ds-badge-c6 { background: #201d17; color: #f1efe5; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Upload/text input, Plex Mono type, stamp-colored focus ring.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Nome encontrado no PDF" />
components.css: .ds-input { padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #d5cfba; border-radius: 3px; font-size: 0.82rem; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; background: #faf9f3; width: 100%; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #8a1f3d; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(138,31,61,.14); }

narrative.overview:
This is a redesign, replacing the earlier 'Trust Ledger' fintech-SaaS world (navy header, blue→purple gradient, pill buttons) with a world literal to the product's own name: a 'Conferência de Caixa' (cash register reconciliation) rendered as an actual register tape. The page reads as paper, not glass: warm off-white receipt stock, ink-black type, a single stamp-red accent used the way a rubber 'CONFERIDO' stamp is used — sparingly, with authority, never as a gradient wash.

Every rectangle in the previous world was a pill or a heavily rounded card; this world cuts paper instead — small, consistent corner radii (3/6/10px), dashed borders standing in for perforation lines, and a literal torn/perforated edge under the header where the 'tape' separates from the machine. Status is still carried by the same three-color vocabulary as before, but rendered as small ink swatches and colored text rather than thick side borders.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-and-ink material world: warm off-white ground, near-black ink text, one stamp-red accent — no gradients anywhere
Monospace (IBM Plex Mono) for every heading, label, and data value — the 'printed' register-tape voice; IBM Plex Sans carries prose only
Small, consistent corner radii and dashed 'perforation' borders replace the old pill/gradient language entirely
Status and sector identity read through small ink-swatch dots and text color, never a thick colored side-border

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: #8a1f3d is the only saturated color used for brand/interactive purposes. It never appears as a gradient, wash, or background fill larger than a button or icon.

rules.name: The No-Gradient Rule
rules.body: This world has zero gradients, replacing the prior 'Trust Ledger' world's blue→purple CTA gradient entirely. Flat ink or flat stamp-red only.

rules.name: The Printed-Numbers Rule
rules.body: Any value that is a number, a date, a time, or currency renders in Plex Mono, never Plex Sans — this is what makes the page read as a ledger rather than an app.

rules.name: The Flat-Paper Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. A card sitting on the page looks like paper sitting on paper — bordered, not elevated — until the user's cursor proves it's interactive.

rules.name: The Cut-Paper Rule
rules.body: Every corner resolves to 3, 6, or 10px. A pill anywhere in this system is a regression to the old world, not a valid exception.

dos: Do render every number, date, and time in IBM Plex Mono — this is the detail that sells the 'printed tape' concept.
Do keep the Stamp accent (#8a1f3d) flat — no gradients, no tints used as backgrounds.
Do resolve every corner to 3/6/10px; no pills.
Do use dashed borders specifically to signal a 'perforation' (upload zones, export button, dividers) — not as a generic input style.
donts: Don't reintroduce a side-border color accent on cards or entries — use the ink-swatch dot pattern instead.
Don't mix in the prior world's blue/purple tokens; they are fully retired, not a fallback.
Don't add shadow-driven elevation at rest; this world's depth comes from paper/ink contrast and borders.
Don't use emoji as inline icons in the live UI — Bootstrap Icons is the icon system throughout.
